scientific_integrity.historical_priority: Provisional; published general intersection machinery is credited.
scientific_integrity.method: Degeneracy locus classes, Grassmannian Schubert calculus, and projective bundle pushforward using exact rational arithmetic.
scientific_integrity.verification: Exact standard-library verifier returns VERIFY_OK and reproduces both degree sequences by two methods.

scientific_limitations: The stated cycle classes and mixed degrees concern only the two natural incidence loci inside the product of the quintic del Pezzo threefold and Gr(2,7).
The result does not determine the full moduli space Chow ring or the scheme-theoretic singular ideal.
The Pluecker-only degree 504 follows also from the known degree-twelve discriminant; it is not claimed as a new theorem.
An older implicit computation of the same complete mixed-degree tables cannot be excluded.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Complete mixed degrees of two canonical strata on the quintic del Pezzo threefold
